ops.title: cc-pool tests write into the real home when HOME is not sandboxed
ops.description:
v0.64.9 (980cc00) paired `DAEMONKIT_HOME` with every existing
`t.Setenv("HOME", …)` via the new `internal/testhome.Sandbox`, closing the
daemonkit-side escape that daemonkit v0.20.9 opened (its `internal/realhome`
resolves the passwd home and ignores `HOME`). Two holes remain.

## 1. Tests that never sandbox HOME at all

`internal/cli/rename_test.go` and `internal/statusapp/hooks_test.go` build a
`pool.Manager` over a temp store but never move `HOME`, so `pool.StateDir()`
resolves to the invoking user's real `~/.cc-pool`. A local
`scripts/test.sh -race ./...` on 2026-07-27 created 20+ symlinks under
`~/.cc-pool/config/<hash>`, several pointing at `t.TempDir()` paths that no
longer exist (`TestRunRenameAuto…/002`) and several at the live
`~/Library/CloudStorage/CCPoolStatus-acct-NN` roots. This predates the
daemonkit bump: `pool.Home()` is `os.UserHomeDir()`, which reads `HOME`.

Fix: route these through `testhome.Sandbox` like the other 98 sites.

## 2. FuseKit resolves the passwd home independently

Blocking #1: with `HOME` and `DAEMONKIT_HOME` both pointed at a scratch dir,
`TestDefaultCandidatePlanAcceptsAbsentFixedTarget` fails:

    FuseKit runtime: runtime directory "/tmp/<scratch>/.cc-pool/fusekit"
    is not below user home "/Users/yasyf"

FuseKit v1.15.5 resolves the real home itself and honors neither `HOME` nor
`DAEMONKIT_HOME`, so sandboxing `HOME` in that test trades pollution for a
failure. FuseKit needs its own env seam (mirroring daemonkit's
`realhome.EnvOverride`) before #1 can be finished.

Evidence: a full suite run under `HOME=DAEMONKIT_HOME=<scratch>` is green
except that one test, and leaves the real home untouched (0 new
`~/.cc-pool/config` entries); the same run under the ambient `HOME` is fully
green but pollutes.

ops.text: A full scripts/test.sh run under a scratch HOME leaves the invoking user's ~/.cc-pool and ~/.daemonkit byte-identical
